chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Aban ibn 'Uthman from a man from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
It is recommended for the single pilgrim (mufrid) to tread the Mash'ar al-Haram and to enter the Kaaba.
The Sheikh (may Allah have mercy on him) said: When the sun rises, he should depart from it to Mina.

key_terms.الشَّيْخ: The Sheikh (referring to al-Tusi in this context)
key_terms.الصَّرُورَة: Single pilgrim (mufrid) who performs Hajj only

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended rituals for a single pilgrim at Mash'ar al-Haram and Kaaba during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific Sunnahs for the Mufrid during the stay at Muzdalifah, emphasizing the recommendation to tread the Mash'ar al-Haram and enter the Kaaba before dawn. It concludes with the critical transition ritual: upon sunrise, the pilgrim must depart for Mina to perform the Rami (stoning) of the Jamarat, marking the shift from the spiritual gathering to the ritual acts of Hajj.
